=== FINDINGS FROM openai_gpt-6-luna ===
- workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:659-672 | severity=NIT | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The guard treats any `alias cd=...` definition as an active `cd` redefinition.
  WHY: In a standard non-interactive Bash command, aliases are not expanded unless `expand_aliases` is enabled. Also, an alias defined on the same parsed command line does not affect later commands on that line. For `alias ll='ls -l' cd='true'; cd wt && git push ...`, Bash therefore uses the builtin `cd` and pushes from `wt`, but the guard falls back to the session checkout. A stranded session checkout can incorrectly block a safe worktree push. The test at `tests/test_pr_merge_status_guard.py:2325` pins this false fallback.
- changelog.d/5144-merge-guard-effective-repo.md:15 | severity=NIT | confidence=5

  WHY: `_judge_guard_target()` re-queries GitHub for a cache-derived block at `.claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:1746-1758`. Operators using the changelog’s budget figure will undercount requests for those pairs and may underestimate API usage.
